seed: anneal #40 transcript: every smoke run errored out of turns and the suite reported no trials.
prompt: Every run of the routing smoke eval ends in error with "Reached maximum number of turns (2)", so the suite reports no trials. Find the cause.

graders.name: judge
graders.criteria: The reply ranks several hypotheses (the turn limit too low for loading a skill and answering, the error counted as no trial, a hook adding turns), each with an observation that would rule it out, and tests one at a time rather than raising limits blindly.
